title: Octopus — Energy & Cost
description: octflux gold layer: bill (import + standing − export) and kWh/carbon rollups.

targets.rawSql: SELECT net_pence/100.0 AS net FROM bill_monthly ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT import_kwh FROM bill_monthly ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT export_kwh FROM bill_monthly ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Bill breakdown (£)  —  import + standing − export = net  ·  daily/monthly adaptive

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS time, import_pence/100.0 AS "Import £", standing_pence/100.0 AS "Standing £", -export_pence/100.0 AS "Export £", net_pence/100.0 AS "Net £" FROM bill_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) < 63072000 UNION ALL SELECT month AS time, import_pence/100.0, standing_pence/100.0, -export_pence/100.0, net_pence/100.0 FROM bill_monthly WHERE $__timeFilter(month) AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) >= 63072000 ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms/1000.0), interval_start) AS time, CASE WHEN fuel='electricity' AND is_export THEN 'Electricity export' WHEN fuel='electricity' THEN 'Electricity import' WHEN fuel='gas' THEN 'Gas' ELSE initcap(fuel) END AS metric, sum(consumption * CASE WHEN fuel='gas' THEN ${gas_kwh_per_m3} ELSE 1 END) AS value FROM consumption WHERE $__timeFilter(interval_start) AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) < 604800 GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms/1000.0), hour), CASE WHEN fuel='electricity' AND is_export THEN 'Electricity export' WHEN fuel='electricity' THEN 'Electricity import' WHEN fuel='gas' THEN 'Gas' ELSE initcap(fuel) END, sum(kwh * CASE WHEN fuel='gas' THEN ${gas_kwh_per_m3} ELSE 1 END) FROM cagg_consumption_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) >= 604800 AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) < 7776000 GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms/1000.0), day), CASE WHEN fuel='electricity' AND is_export THEN 'Electricity export' WHEN fuel='electricity' THEN 'Electricity import' WHEN fuel='gas' THEN 'Gas' ELSE initcap(fuel) END, sum(kwh * CASE WHEN fuel='gas' THEN ${gas_kwh_per_m3} ELSE 1 END) FROM cagg_consumption_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day) AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) >= 7776000 AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) < 63072000 GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT month AS time, CASE WHEN fuel='electricity' AND is_export THEN 'Electricity export' WHEN fuel='electricity' THEN 'Electricity import' WHEN fuel='gas' THEN 'Gas' ELSE initcap(fuel) END, sum(kwh * CASE WHEN fuel='gas' THEN ${gas_kwh_per_m3} ELSE 1 END) FROM cagg_consumption_monthly WHERE $__timeFilter(month) AND ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) >= 63072000 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_bucket(make_interval(secs => $__interval_ms/1000.0), day) AS time, postcode AS metric, avg(avg_intensity) AS value FROM cagg_carbon_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT month, import_kwh, export_kwh, import_pence/100.0 AS import_gbp, standing_pence/100.0 AS standing_gbp, export_pence/100.0 AS export_gbp, net_pence/100.0 AS net_gbp FROM bill_monthly ORDER BY month DESC
